ios.desc:
Sepnia allows you to add tasks inside calendar event. Now with just one quick glance you can see events and scheduled tasks for the day right in your calendar.


• Sync with your local calendar
• Show event that currently in-progress
• Plan tasks you're going to work in "Active Tasks"
• Group later tasks in "Inbox"
• Keep track of missed tasks


If you have any question, feel free to reach us at satrio@sepnia.com.

Our Term of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
